digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center Transport - outbound status transitions
propositions: transition_issue_by_name matches against transition name but callers pass destination status name, causing lookups to miss on workflows where these differ
when a transition name and destination status name diverge (e.g. transition 'Start Progress' to status 'In Progress'), the lookup fails and the soft-fails into bridge_alerts without raising an error
some status changes sync while others silently fail depending on whether transition and status names coincide, appearing as flaky partial bridge rather than a mapping defect
transition resolution should match against both transition name (exact match preferred) and destination status name (to.name field), with ambiguity raising rather than guessing
